long_biography.plain_text:
Hans-Peter Wild studied law and business before managing mineral-oil, chemicals and shipping operations outside his family firm. He joined his parents' company in 1974 and drove international growth in natural flavour systems and Capri-Sun. Product expansion and distinctive marketing helped turn the inherited enterprise into two global food-and-beverage businesses.

Wild and KKR sold WILD Flavors to ADM in 2014 through a transaction valued at €2.3 billion. He retained Capri-Sun and remains its owner and chairman, providing strategic direction to a privately held brand sold in more than 100 countries. The fortune began with Rudolf and Leonie Wild's enterprise, but its later scale reflects their son's sustained operating expansion.
